description: Check the HTTP security headers of a website with one live HTTPS GET: redirect chain (up to 5 hops), final status, HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy and COOP, with a simple A-F header grade and findings. Use it for web-hardening checks; it is not a vulnerability scan. The page body is not read or stored. Costs $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (payment goes in _meta["x402/payment"]); invalid input or an upstream failure returns an error and is not charged.

domain.description: Hostname or URL, e.g. example.com or https://www.example.com/path

name: check_security_headers
